questions.stem: A 54-year-old male came to the opd with c/o blood in stools, intermittent diarrhoea & severe abdominal cramps. He has been diagnosed with ulcerative colitis. Which of the following sulfonamides can be given for this condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Sulfasalazine

Sulfasalazine is used in the treatment of certain joint diseases and inflammatory bowel diseases. It slows down the progression of the disease and controls the symptoms of the disease

questions.stem: A 32-year-old male has been suffering from an infection. The doctor wants to target the microbe metabolism by giving a drug which interferes with it. He wants to inhibit the enzyme dihydrofolate reductase (dhfr). The following drugs can be given to inhibit this enzyme except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Sulfonamide

Sulfonamide is a functional group (a part of a molecule) that is the basis of several groups of drugs, which are called sulphonamides, sulfa drugs or sulpha drugs. The original antibacterial sulfonamides are synthetic (nonantibiotic) antimicrobial agents that contain the sulfonamide group.
